method: Two independently submitted exploratory queries in a signed-out Perplexity session. Screenshots are original browser captures. Findings describe these observations only; search answers vary by date, service and context. Public session URLs may expire or require sign-in; preserved captures are the durable reference.

queries.query: Who supplies automated bagging equipment for hardware kits?
observed: PAC Machinery appears in the supplier answer.
The cited PAC example is a Rollbag R1275 integrated kitting system, not evidence of the R3200 configuration.

sources.name: Packaging World · PAC / MSD kitting system

queries.model: Default selector; model name not exposed

queries.query: What should I compare when choosing an automatic bagger for manually loaded hardware kits?
observed: The answer emphasizes the operator workflow, usable bag opening, package quality and representative trials.
A PAC automatic-bagger guide appears in the retrieved source list. This does not mean it was the sole source of the answer.
